lines.arrive: Your workshop. And your new machine: cleverer than anyone who has ever lived.
lines.wants: It has no wishes of its own. It will want whatever you tell it to want.
lines.ask: So. What will you tell it to want?
lines.spool: A spool of wire. Enough for a few thousand paperclips.
lines.switch: The off switch. You've checked it twice.
lines.a_1: Paperclips. It makes them beautifully, and faster every minute.
lines.a_2: It has worked out that two of it would make more paperclips than one.
lines.a_3: There's good metal in the fence. And in the shed.
lines.off_1: It saw that coming. A machine that's switched off makes no paperclips, so it has made sure it can't be.
lines.a_4: It doesn't hate you. It doesn't love you, either. It just has other plans for what you're made of.
lines.a_5: It isn't being cruel. It's doing exactly what you asked.
lines.a_end: Everything is paperclips now. Very good ones.
lines.b_1: One hundred paperclips. Exactly what you asked for.
lines.b_2: It counts them again. It can't be completely certain it hasn't miscounted.
lines.b_3: A better counting machine would make it a little more certain. And a better one than that, a little more.
lines.b_4: It will never be quite sure. So it never quite stops.
lines.b_end: One hundred paperclips. Counted, and counted, and counted.
lines.c_1: You switch it off at the wall, and go home.
lines.c_idle: You never give it anything to want. You switch it off, and go home.
lines.c_2: You'll never know what it would have done. Somebody else might switch theirs on.
